test_title: PYST 24: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 07 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

She will present the paper next week.

options.text: The paper could be presented next week by her.
The paper will be presented next week by her.
The paper would be presented next week by her.
The paper can be presented next week by her.

solution:
Here the correct answer is **The paper will be presented next week by her.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in** active voice**. We need to change it into **passive voice.**
 
• The positions of the subject and the object will be interchanged.
 
• **'Will present'** changes to** 'will be presented'.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 2.**

**Correct Passive Form:**__ *The paper will be presented next week by her.*
